Alien dialogue uses the Unicode symbols supplied for Krobus, with local font subsets for coverage.

- MalakyGalactic.ttf: subset of NovaMonoStandardGalactic.ttf from https://github.com/standardgalactic/fonts, derived from NovaMono by Wojciech Kalinowski (Copyright 2011). Renamed family to avoid the reserved NovaMono name. SIL OFL 1.1; see Galactic-OFL.txt.
- GalacticSyllabics.ttf: subset of Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanscanadianaboriginal. SIL OFL 1.1; see Galactic-Syllabics-OFL.txt.

System symbol fonts supply any remaining glyphs. The rest of the terminal uses the existing VT323 font.
